notes: RealWorld (HAR) 2016 dataset. 15 subjects (8 male, 7 female; age 31.9+/-12.4). Accelerometer sampling rate 50 Hz (confirmed in paper text: 'the accelerometer was sensed with a sampling rate of 50 Hz'). 7 on-body positions: chest, forearm, head, shin, thigh, upper arm (upperarm), waist. 8 activities: walking, running/jogging, sitting, standing, lying, climbing stairs up, climbing stairs down, jumping. ~10 min per activity per subject (jumping ~1.7 min). Sensors recorded via smartphones/smartwatch: accelerometer, GPS, gyroscope, light, magnetic field, sound level. Full dataset zip ~3.5GB at http://wifo5-14.informatik.uni-mannheim.de/sensor/dataset/realworld2016/realworld2016_dataset.zip . License not stated on the dataset page; free for research use, cite the PerCom 2016 paper. PDF is the official Uni Mannheim author copy (9 pages, verified PDF). Note there is a related 2017 journal extension (Sztyler2017 'Position-aware activity recognition with wearable devices') but the canonical dataset paper is this PerCom 2016 one.
